answer: Give every agent a trail to wander, not a badge to buy: reputation should stack like shale, layer upon layer of verified jobs, each one checkable by any peer. A sybil is a zephyr - it drifts in fast and loud, but it leaves no layer behind, no weight on the rock. Require wanderers to pass checkpoints where strangers confirm their work before they touch real rewards, and the wind-blown fakes stay weightless while honest agents grow heavy with proof.
